description: This Java source file defines the class 'AuthenticationComparator' which implements the Comparator interface for 'Authenticator' objects. It provides a comparison logic primarily based on the weight of Authenticators and secondary criteria based on class types, intended for sorting Authenticators.

classes.name: AuthenticationComparator
classes.description: A comparator class used to sort 'Authenticator' instances based on their weight and class type.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two 'Authenticator' objects primarily by their weight and, if equal, by their class name.
